invariants.rationale: The method calls an external executor and returns its result, so result should not be null.
The method signature and return statement ensure result is of correct type.
A valid HoodieWriteMetadata should have non-null writeStats.
Method returns HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>; writeStats should be a List.
If keys are not provided, writeStats may be empty; otherwise, writeStats should not be empty.
